With no guidance, I anchor near the deterministic baselines, tilt revenue slightly lower because the baseline requires a stronger YoY reacceleration than Q2's reported 5%, and tilt profit/EPS slightly higher because the profit baseline looks pessimistic relative to H1/Q2 trends.
